scenes.title: ScopeProof: clearer scope before you commit
scenes.caption: For freelance developers who turn client messages into fixed-scope work. This captioned montage shows actual local runs, with processing gaps omitted.

scenes.title: Start with the client’s exact words
scenes.caption: This synthetic brief asks for one responsive landing page, four sections, and supplied copy and images. The four service offers and all prices are illustrative.

scenes.title: A checked sample estimate: USD 120
scenes.caption: The real Strands and Qwen3 run took 33.02 seconds on this CPU. Two tool calls read the catalog and validated the scope. Code applies the catalog price.

scenes.title: Inspect the evidence behind the included work
scenes.caption: Each source sentence is preserved exactly. Capability IDs and quantities are checked by code. Exact text is evidence of what was requested, not proof of feasibility.

scenes.title: Login and checkout change the scope
scenes.caption: The second real run took 30.30 seconds. The estimate becomes Unpriced; login and subscription payments are excluded from the static-page package.

scenes.title: Finish with a reviewable artifact
scenes.caption: Copy the draft reply or export a ZIP with scope, questions, risks, source evidence and a checklist. The pack was downloaded and checked. No client message is sent.

scenes.title: Inspect the real model and tool trace
scenes.caption: A separate CSV sample also completed: 31.28 seconds, two model calls and two tools. This local prototype uses Strands, Ollama and FastAPI. Human review remains essential.
